headline: Fox's $22 Billion Roku Deal Poised to Clear US Antitrust Review, Semafor Reports
summary: Fox's planned $22 billion acquisition of streaming platform Roku is poised to clear antitrust review by United States regulators, according to Semafor.
why: Fox and Roku are major media and streaming technology companies. Regulatory clearance removes a key barrier to large-scale media consolidation.

impacts.name: Roku Inc
impacts.why: Clearance of antitrust review brings the $22 billion buyout closer to completion, supporting Roku shares toward the deal price.
